from pathlib import Path
import datetime,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,sys,tarfile,time
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;a=root/'startup-transport.tar.gz';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert sha(a.read_bytes())=='861fdfa4240cda7fac101a2ecb4d698d5d9673c3f8e66be76e569bc8c2a3eb39'
with tarfile.open(a)as t:
 members=t.getmembers();assert len(members)==len({m.name for m in members})and all(m.isfile()and not m.name.startswith('/')and'..'not in Path(m.name).parts for m in members)
 manifest=json.loads(t.extractfile('bundle-manifest.json').read());assert manifest['registrationSha256']=='e2ab7db93a9526e33e2f432ea83d1b96dd4575180fc64452e25e9ff1eea731dc'
 assert {m.name for m in members}=={r['path']for r in manifest['files']}|{'bundle-manifest.json'}
 for r in manifest['files']:
  b=t.extractfile(r['path']).read();assert len(b)==r['bytes']and sha(b)==r['sha256'];dest=root/r['path'];dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
  if dest.exists():assert dest.is_file()and not dest.is_symlink()and dest.read_bytes()==b,r['path']
  else:
   with dest.open('xb')as f:f.write(b)
 with(root/'bundle-manifest.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(manifest,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
p=root/manifest['newCapsuleName'];parent=root/manifest['parentCapsuleName'];reg=json.loads((p/'registration.json').read_text())
assert sha((p/'registration.json').read_bytes())==manifest['registrationSha256']and time.time()<reg['deadlineUnix']and shutil.disk_usage(p).free>=reg['minimumFreeBytes']
for name,target in manifest['relativeLinks'].items():
 assert '/'not in name and not(p/name).exists();os.symlink(target,p/name,target_is_directory=name=='sources')
# Reuse only this campaign's already installed package bytes; common metadata resolves to the new frozen physical copy.
existing=Path.home()/'hoc-research/barrel-forecast-mixture-v11-confirmation-20261117/candidate/node_modules';assert existing.is_dir()
modules=parent/'candidate/node_modules';modules.mkdir()
for source in existing.iterdir():
 if source.name=='@heroesofcrypto':continue
 os.symlink(source.resolve(),modules/source.name,target_is_directory=source.is_dir())
scope=modules/'@heroesofcrypto';scope.mkdir();os.symlink('../../sources/common',scope/'common',target_is_directory=True)
os.symlink(os.path.relpath(modules,p),p/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
assert shutil.which('bun')
with(p/'node-unit-tests.log').open('x')as log:subprocess.run(['nice','-n','19','bun','test','--preload','./alias.ts','./root-scope.test.ts'],cwd=p,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=60)
assert not(p/'status.json').exists()
launch={'at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'registrationSha256':manifest['registrationSha256'],'stage':'launching-once','all6972TransportMembersExact':True,'nodeCodeTestsPassed':True,'deadlineUtc':reg['deadlineUtc'],'unixNice':19,'workers':reg['localWorkers']}
with(p/'launch.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(launch,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
with(p/'controller.log').open('xb')as log:proc=subprocess.Popen(['nice','-n','19',sys.executable,'run.py'],cwd=p,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
launch.update({'stage':'launched','pid':proc.pid});tmp=p/'launch.tmp';tmp.write_text(json.dumps(launch,indent=2)+'\n');tmp.replace(p/'launch.json');print(json.dumps(launch))
